events.body: [worker workerA r2] {"commands": ["cd /app/linux-6.9 && make defconfig && scripts/config --enable MODULES && make -j$(nproc) && echo 'Insert printk before start_kernel call' && sed -i '/^static void __init start_kernel(void)/a\\\\tprintk(KERN_INFO \"Hello, this is a custom kernel\");' init/main.c && make -j$(nproc)"]}

[worker workerB r1] {"commands": ["cd /app && ls -la", "find / -maxdepth 2 -name 'linux-6.9*' -type d 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 2 -name 'initramfs*' 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 2 -name 'ramfs*' 2>/dev/null; tmux wait -S done"]}
[worker workerA r1] {"commands": ["cat /app/data.hex | head -n 100 | xxd -r > /tmp/restored_bin 2>/dev/null || hexdump -e '1/1 \"%02x\"' /tmp/raw 2>/dev/null; file /tmp/restored_bin"]}

[worker workerA r3] {"commands": ["head -n 10 /app/data.hex", "cat /app/data.hex | head -n 100 | xxd -r -p > /tmp/restored_bin 2>/dev/null; file /tmp/restored_bin", "xxd -r -p < /app/data.hex > /tmp/restored_bin 2>/dev/null; file /tmp/restored_bin", "head -n 1 /app/data.hex | xxd -p | tr -d '\\n' | cut -c1-16 | xxd -r
